description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application's frontend, responsible for rendering the root component `<App />` into the DOM element with ID 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component, then initializes and renders the React application.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a concurrent root for rendering React components into a DOM node.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot().render
methods.description: Renders the specified React element into the root DOM node.
